planets.name: HAT-P-20 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-20 with a 2.88-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-20 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-20. Its orbit and size follow Bakos et al. 2010's fit, the archive's default.
